# Program cover illustrations

These seven SVG files are original conceptual vector/UI illustrations created for the AI PATH program catalog. They communicate a learning direction; they are **not screenshots, student work, completed client projects, evidence of grants, or measured results**.

| File | Concept |
| --- | --- |
| `explore.svg` | A compass and two exploratory project pathways |
| `books.svg` | Book design and manuscript preparation |
| `ml.svg` | A schematic learning graph and notebook chart |
| `hack.svg` | A prototype interface and presentation board |
| `grant.svg` | Proposal documents and preparation milestones |
| `frontier.svg` | Experimental exploration and observation notes |
| `vibe.svg` | A conceptual modular app and kanban board |

Authored directly as SVG for this repository. Each file is 720 × 440, self-contained, and contains no external images, fonts, scripts, tracking, or remote requests. Shapes, graphs, and interface panels are illustrative. There are no real names, customer records, financial figures, or promises of outcomes.

Existing real project screenshots and their provenance elsewhere in `assets/` are unchanged. Keep these conceptual covers clearly identified as illustrations in the catalog where needed; do not add them to galleries of actual project results.
